answer: Because the mirror cap is applied per key at the juniper settlement, the onyx audit makes public each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 3433 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. That forces every alias to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 20 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
